candidates.title: AutoScout: Structured Optimization for Automating ML System Configuration
candidates.abstract: Machine learning (ML) systems expose a rapidly expanding configuration space spanning model-parallelism strategies, communication optimizations, and low-level runtime parameters. End-to-end system efficiency is highly sensitive to these choices, yet identifying high-performance configurations is challenging due to heterogeneous feature types (e.g., sparse and dense parameters), conditional dependencies (e.g., valid execution parameters only under specific upstream decisions), and the high search (profiling) cost. Existing approaches either optimize a narrow subset of configuration dimensions or rely on ad-hoc heuristics that fail to generalize as configuration spaces continue to grow. We present AutoScout, a general-purpose systems configurator for ML training, fine-tuning, and inference. It formulates the system configuration as a mixed-discrete/continuous optimization problem with hierarchical dependencies and introduces a hybrid optimization framework that jointly refines sparse structural decisions and dense execution parameters. To reduce profiling cost, AutoScout adaptively prioritizes high-impact configuration features and ensembles simulators with varying fidelity. Across diverse models, hardware platforms, and deployment objectives, AutoScout consistently identifies high-performance configurations, achieving 2.7-3.0$\times$ training speedup over expert-tuned settings.
candidates.reason: AutoScoutはモデル並列戦略・通信最適化・低レベル実行時パラメータを含むMLシステム構成空間を、階層依存を持つ混合離散連続最適化として定式化し、プロファイリング費用を下げつつ学習・微調整・推論のエンドツーエンド効率を高める構成探索と多忠実度シミュレータ統合を提案しており、推論基盤の構成最適化への直接貢献が要旨で確認できる。

candidates.title: RoCC: Harnessing Raster Operations Pipeline for Efficient Tensor Collective Communication
candidates.abstract: This paper introduces RoCC, which enables finegrained overlapping between compute and collective communication (CC) phases of LLM computing on GPUs, by offloading the CC to underutilized raster operations pipelines (ROPs). ROPs can provide fruitful performance for CC as they reside near the memory and have reduction computation capability. We first reverse engineer the ROP microarchitecture of two GPU architectures to model ROPs and add small logics to enable asynchronous computing and messaging for CC. We also decompose any CC operations into a sequence of ROP microoperations. In our cycle-level simulations of a 4- to 8-GPU node with LLM training workloads, RoCC delivers an average of 51% and 23% speedups over the non-overlapping baseline and oracle kernel fusion, with only $\mathbf{2. 4 \%} \mathbf{L2}$ cache worth of area. On larger systems with 32 to 256 GPUs, RoCC consistently achieves speedups from 13-21%.
candidates.reason: RoCCはGPUの未活用なラスタ演算パイプラインへ集合通信をオフロードし、LLM計算における計算フェーズと集合通信フェーズを細粒度に重ねることで、複数GPUノードでのLLMワークロードを高速化するハードウェア・通信機構であり、分散推論・学習共通のLLM実行基盤への直接的な技術貢献が要旨で具体的に示されている。

candidates.title: Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling for Diffusion Draft Trees
candidates.abstract: Speculative sampling accelerates diffusion generation by verifying inexpensive draft states in parallel while preserving the target law. Recent tree-based methods allocate the parallel compute budget more effectively than single-chain drafts, as demonstrated by Diffusion Greedy Rejection Sampling (D-GRS). D-GRS generates $K$ conditionally independent candidates per node, and sequentially tests them in their generation order. Yet the sampled candidates admit an informative ranking without additional target-model evaluations. To exploit this, we introduce Rank-Aware Speculative Sampling (RASS), a verification rule for speculative draft trees based on rank-aware list coupling. RASS orders draft candidates along the proposal-target mean displacement and samples a rank with weights optimized to minimize total variation between the selected-proposal and target laws. Finally, the selected candidate is maximally coupled with the target, with residual correction ensuring exact sampling for any choice of rank weights. We evaluate RASS on a Gaussian-mixture target, unconditional pixel-space generation on FFHQ, conditional generation on CIFAR-10, and latent diffusion with Stable Diffusion 3.5 using COCO2014 prompts. Measured by the ratio of standard to speculative sampling's target-model evaluation counts, RASS improves on D-GRS across the evaluated settings, with gains reaching approximately 20% on CIFAR-10 at matched compute budgets.
candidates.reason: Rank-Aware Speculative Samplingは拡散生成の投機的サンプリングにおいて、ドラフト木の候補を提案分布と目標分布の平均変位で順位付けし、順位重みを最適化したリスト結合で検証することで並列計算予算を有効に使う検証規則を提案しており、投機的デコード系の生成高速化への直接貢献が要旨で確認できる。
